title: Hardcoded Static Authorization Token and Identity UUIDs
description: API service classes define a hardcoded static bearer token (`static const _token = '1'`) and static identity UUIDs for authenticating backend requests across all installed client instances.
attack_vector: Attackers inspect client code or intercept a single request to learn the static authorization token and UUID, enabling unauthorized access to any family or child monitoring record on the API.
fix_rationale: Eliminate static tokens and hardcoded UUIDs. Provision per-session, cryptographically random OAuth2/JWT bearer tokens stored in hardware-backed secure storage.
